assumptions: All 111 chips are from the unchanged frozen test role.
RTC scene selection uses metadata and exact C2S acquisition identity before raster reads.
Both RTC dates use compatible linear gamma0, platform, relative orbit, direction and exact target grid.
Labels include permanent water; the change baseline targets new inundation.
Existing models and calibrators trained on GRD remain frozen; applying them to RTC is a domain transfer.
Same post-RTC inputs and joint valid masks permit a pipeline comparison, not newly flooded-land accuracy.
Missing matched pairs are exclusions; no alternate event date or product is substituted.
acquisition.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; RTC by Catalyst, hosted by Microsoft. C2S-MS labels: Cloud to Street, Microsoft, Radiant Earth (2022), DOI10.34911/rdnt.oz32gz.

assumptions: Event-date water labels include permanent water; newly flooded land is not separately labelled.
WorldCover 2021 and JRC 1984-2020 are retrospective context for older C2S-MS events.
HAND and TWI are existing nearest-drainage and distance/slope approximations.

Drainage is the existing lowest-2-percentile DEM fallback, used consistently for all inputs; when DEM pixels are missing the percentile uses original finite pixels only, and filled pixels cannot become drainage. Filled DEM pixels and immediate neighbours remain invalid.
Rainfall and delta-SAR channels are omitted unless actually acquired in a separate arm.
Context abstention vetoes WorldCover built-up pixels and a potential-shadow heuristic (slope >=15 degrees, VV <-18 dB, VH <-25 dB); this is not a validated shadow classifier.
No qualified Thai reference exists; no Mae Sai accuracy is claimed.
All outputs are report-only and cannot feed the decision layer.
Models, calibrators and abstention policies were fitted on GRD and remain frozen.
RTC gamma0 differs from training GRD sigma0: these results measure domain transfer.
Hand labels include permanent water; the change ramp targets newly inundated land.
No permanent-water mask is inferred from test labels or used to change the target.
The subset contains 46 of 111 test chips from 2 of 3 events; 65 Australian chips lack a matched pre image.
Every full-valid method score uses the same label/features/ramp valid-pixel intersection.
Each frozen selective policy has its own coverage; selective metrics are not a common-mask ranking.
This is a matched-input pipeline comparison, not new-flood accuracy or a full-benchmark baseline win.
No Thai accuracy, operational validation or decision-layer use is established.
